violated_contract: An in-flight Android recording file transfer (CV1 BLE drain or phone-disk cloud upload) must stay scheduled for its own lifetime. Activity paused / screen-off is allowed to refuse new discovery passes, but it must not drop the CPU/process keep-alive the current transfer is using or leave Dart WAL drains to Doze once the screen turns off.
canonical_prevention: Hold a dataSync foreground service plus PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK for the transfer refcount: acquire at RecordingTransferCoordinator pass start and SyncProvider._performSync, release on complete, cancelSync, or Flutter engine death. Coordinator wake() lets an in-flight pass finish after setForeground(false), does not queue another whole-WAL drain from background connectivity, and drops a coalesced extra pass when the screen turns off. Behavioral coverage: coordinator in-flight drain after screen-off, no second pass from background connectivity or a queued extra wake, keep-alive refcount, and SyncProvider acquire/release around syncWal plus immediate releaseAll on cancel.
